title: Megan Thee Stallion Teases ‘Act III’ Album: ‘I’m Back’
contentText:
Megan Thee Stallion is entering a new era. The Houston Hottie teased her upcoming Act: III album in a tantalizing Instagram post on Monday (Aug. 10).

Related

Cardi B Celebrates ‘WAP’ Going Diamond With Megan Thee Stallion: We ‘Really Did That’

Megan Thee Stallion Declares ‘All That Wifey S–t Is Dead’ While Teasing New Music Following Klay Thompson Split

Kelly Clarkson Jokes About This 'Perfect' Body Part Peeking Out After a Wardrobe Malfunction During Las Vegas Show

The 31-year-old rapper shared a series of photos that seemingly signal the return of her Tina Snow alter-ego, with “Act: III” inked in white on her upper back and a snowflake emoji in the caption. As Michael Jordan succinctly said in his two-word statement announcing his return to the NBA in 1995, Megan declared “I’m Back” on the final slide of the post, which Roc Nation reshared in its IG Stories.

The Hotties went into a frenzy about new music being on the way to close out 2026. “B—h I’m so READYYYYYYYYYYY,” one person wrote on IG. Another fan added: “Give me a release date I need to clear my schedule!”

Megan has hinted at Act: III ‘s arrival dating as far back as December 2024. “Real Hot Girl S–t ACT 3 2025 … be ready hotties,”  she wrote on X at the time.

As far as a release date, Megan Thee Stallion hasn’t locked in anything just yet for Act: III . The rapper’s most recent album was Megan in June 2024, which debuted at No. 3 on the Billboard 200 with 64,000 total album-equivalent units, according to Luminate. She followed up with the Act: II deluxe in October of the same year.

Earlier in August, Megan Thee Stallion celebrated picking up her first Diamond plaque for her 2020 “WAP” collaboration with Cardi B. “WOWW omg diamond sisterrr thank you for having me,” she wrote on X.

While Megan hasn’t released a single in 2026, she’s kept busy hopping on Bossman Dlow’s “Motion Party” remix and Juvenile’s Billboard Hot 100 hit “B.B.B.”
